gameDescriptionHtml:
Thalamus Is a story based game that takes place in France. You play the role of an average employee who is a little too curious discovering how truly evil the company he works for is. Follow along each chapter as we unveil the story of Rayan.

Game Features

  • The World: After humanity reaches the limits of silicon technology is stagnant and companies such as Argus Panoptes want to take every bit of information the average citizen has.
  • Stealth: Argus Panoptes is a secure company and doesn’t want people fiddling with their stuff. Intense security measures have been put in to prevent this.The robots are too dangerous to take on head first,so thats why youll have to sneak past them and pray they don’t find you
  • The Enemies: Failed surveillance robots don’t just vanish, thousands are lying in Argus Panoptes sites all over the world, perfect for an army.
  • Argus Panoptes: A surveillance company trying to lobby governments is never a good idea, Argus Panoptes is no different. With over 30 sites all over the world there is no telling what they are capable of.
  • Thalamus: A cancelled project who was never turned off is the perfect cannatite for a villain. It will never stop until the people who abandoned it pay.
  • Imperium: A secret alloy capable of revolutionizing the world would never be made by the good guys. Capable of making a normal computer turn into a revenge hungry robot only top Argus Panoptes employees know it exists.
